purpose: Stress-test low-energy dialogue, guest viewpoint, family-origin pressure, capability failure and six-core voice differentiation before any prose canon is fixed.

probes.test_goal: Can a nearly uneventful year-end group chat distinguish voices without forcing wit, confession or retrospective wisdom?
Can a passerby feel like the center of her own workday while Song Nan appears only as one difficult but useful collaborator?
Can family-origin pressure reappear without illness or melodrama, and can a person with strong communication skills still communicate badly when sibling-role shame is activated?

Expose whether six core characters answer the same practical stimulus with genuinely different attention, syntax, values and blind spots, without turning the exercise into six philosophical monologues.

shared_rules: No family detail beyond fixed ledger structure becomes history.
Dialogue may be dull, repetitive, badly timed or unfinished.
Do not make every line quotable.
A character may know a communication principle and still fail to use it under status, shame or fatigue.
Guest viewpoint must retain a goal that would exist if the protagonist disappeared from the scene.
Endings may stop on logistics or silence rather than meaning.
